record.question: Who is elected as Judge from India at International Court of Justice?
record.explanation: Answer C: Dalveer Bhandari. Dalveer Bhandari was the Indian ICJ member. The Court’s original 21 November 2017 release records his re-election for the nine-year term beginning 6 February 2018. Historical/source note: Historical 2018 court membership; Neeru Chadha’s tribunal was ITLOS, not the ICJ. Reference: https://www.icj-cij.org/node/105520. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
